prompts.front: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game texture, flat orthographic elevation of a Brazilian coastal wine shop named exactly CURITIBA CELLAR. Create a single seamless-border rectangular FRONT FACADE albedo image, width 14 metres and height 3.6 metres, aspect ratio approximately 3.89:1. Full bleed facade only, zero background, sky, ground, perspective or roof visibility. GTA-inspired hand-painted realistic worn sandstone and burgundy timber, brass window frames, bottle displays behind two broad shop windows at natural human scale. Central double sliding door exactly centered; opening occupies horizontal 41.7% to 58.3% and vertical 25.56% to 100% of image. Door reaches bottom edge; no step. Burgundy fascia across upper 22% with only text CURITIBA CELLAR, warm cream letters centered. Two symmetric window bays below fascia. Soft diffuse baked albedo without cast shadows or lights/glow. No people, vehicles, slogans, labels, watermark. Image will be applied to existing 14x3.6m game facade. Save generated image as local output file.
prompts.side: Use case: stylized-concept. Single game architectural albedo texture. Flat straight-on orthographic SIDE WALL of the wine shop Curitiba Cellar.
